items:
Brand New (Just Built) Luxury 30A Beach-View Retreat | Heated Pool + Elevator | Golf Cart (LSV)
** New Listing **
Step into an elevated coastal escape designed for those who value space, comfort, and unrushed time together. This brand-new luxury home in Santa Rosa Beach offers beautiful beach views, a private heated pool, and the rare convenience of a private elevator, all just a short 2–5 minute walk from the sugar-white sands of 30A.

This is a home created for settling in — where mornings are slow, days are sun-filled, and evenings are meant for gathering.

An Elevated 30A Experience
From the moment you arrive, the home feels calm, spacious, and thoughtfully composed. Professionally designed with a refined coastal aesthetic, every detail balances beauty with comfort.
• Private heated pool for relaxed mornings and sunset swims
• Private elevator for effortless movement throughout the home
• Beach views that gently frame your days
• Seven full bathrooms offering rare privacy and ease
• 3,600 sq ft of light-filled living space
• Complimentary 6-Passenger Street-Legal Golf Cart (LSV)

Location | Santa Rosa Beach on Scenic 30A
Perfectly positioned in Santa Rosa Beach, you’re moments from pristine beaches, scenic bike paths, dining, and shopping. Walk to the beach, return for poolside afternoons, and enjoy evenings close to everything — yet removed from the crowds.

Designed for Time Together
Spacious living areas filled with natural light, a fully equipped chef’s kitchen, dining spaces for long conversations,
and outdoor areas that extend the living space seamlessly. Sliding glass doors open directly to the pool area, creating effortless indoor–outdoor flow.

Pool & Outdoor Living
The private pool area is designed to be lived in. Rinse off in the outdoor shower after the beach, prepare drinks or
snacks in the poolside kitchenette and enjoy the convenience of a dedicated poolside bathroom accessed through sliding glass doors — no wet feet through the house.

6-Passenger Street-Legal Golf Cart

For added convenience, the home includes a complimentary 6-passenger street-legal LSV golf cart, making it easy to explore Santa Rosa Beach and the surrounding 30A area at a relaxed coastal pace.

Perfect for quick trips to the beach, nearby restaurants, and local shops, the golf cart is especially appreciated by families and multi-generational groups. Whether you’re heading out for morning coffee, a sunset ride, or an evening dinner, the cart adds ease and enjoyment to your stay.

Use of the golf cart is subject to local laws and guest acknowledgment of safety guidelines.

Golf Cart Use:
Use of the street-legal golf cart is provided as a courtesy. Drivers must be licensed, at least 25 years of age, and comply with all local traffic laws. A signed waiver and proof of insurance may be required prior to use.

Sleeping Arrangements | Comfortably Sleeps 17
• Primary Suite: King bed with ensuite bath
• Guest Suite 1: King bed with ensuite bath
• Guest Suite 2: King bed with ensuite bath
• Guest Suite 3: Queen bed with ensuite bath
• Guest Suite 4 / Bunk Room: Custom bunks for children & teens
• Additional sleeping accommodations where noted

With seven full bathrooms, mornings are peaceful and evenings are effortless.

Elevator Access
The private elevator makes the home ideal for multi-generational families, guests with mobility considerations, and easy transport of luggage, groceries, and beach gear.

Amenities Highlights:
Private heated pool, elevator, poolside kitchenette & bathroom, outdoor shower, beach views, short walk to beach, high-speed Wi-Fi, fully equipped kitchen, washer & dryer, smart TVs, and dedicated parking.

Booking Notes:
Peak season reservations follow a 7-night, Saturday-to-Saturday schedule. This home is best suited for families and respectful adult groups. No parties, events, or gatherings. Quiet hours enforced. Primary renter must be 25+.

** A Home Meant to Be Enjoyed **
This is not a party house. It is a carefully designed coastal retreat meant for connection, rest, and meaningful time together. We look forward to welcoming you to Santa Rosa Beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
